# NeetCode 150

<!-- Generated by tools/build-index.js — do not edit by hand. Run: npm run index -->

The 150 problems from [neetcode.io](https://neetcode.io/practice), grouped by pattern,
in **Kotlin** and **JavaScript**. Every solution explains the idea behind it, names the
trap, and asserts its own edge cases:

```bash
node tools/test-kotlin.js   # compiles and runs every Kotlin solution
node tools/test.js          # runs every JavaScript solution
```

The Kotlin suite needs `kotlinc` (`sdk install kotlin`); the JavaScript suite needs only Node.

**Progress: 150/150 (100%)**

`████████████████████`

⭐ marks the 75 problems that are also on **Blind 75** — the shortlist to do first if
you are short on time.
